name: 29153 · Sumter, SC
findings: ZIP 29153 (Sumter) has 30 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 7 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (71% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 29153 (Sumter) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
30% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 29153 (Sumter) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 43% of the typical level).
